en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale puppets next weekend
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival runs 14-15 November at Victoria Park, featuring illuminated night and grand finale parades with giant puppets.
body: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay on 14 and 15 November for its largest edition yet, organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation.

The free festival at Victoria Park’s central lawn celebrates classic fairy tales through live storytelling in Cantonese and English, African drumming workshops, 17 interactive arts booths, stage performances and an exhibition of more than 900 student artworks.

An illuminated Night Parade starts at 8:30pm on Saturday 14 November from Lee Garden One, with five giant lantern puppets and more than 150 performers. On Sunday 15 November the Grand Finale Parade leaves Victoria Park at 2:30pm, led by ten four-metre-tall puppets and about 500 young participants from local schools.
Giant puppets will also make surprise appearances around the park for photographs during the weekend. The organisers said the event is open to the public with no admission charge.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華下周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話巨型木偶巡遊
zh.dek: 免費戶外青年藝術節於11月14至15日在維園舉行，設夜光及壓軸巡遊，巨型木偶帶領隊伍。
body: 香港青年藝術協會主辦的渣打藝趣嘉年華，於11月14及15日以歷來最盛大陣容重臨銅鑼灣，主題為經典童話。
維多利亞公園中央草坪的免費嘉年華設有廣東話及英語現場講故事、非洲鼓工作坊、17個互動藝術攤位、舞台表演，以及超過900件學生藝術作品展覽。
11月14日（星期六）晚上8時30分，夜光巡遊由利園一期正門出發，五座巨型燈籠木偶及超過150名表演者參與。11月15日（星期日）下午2時30分，壓軸巡遊由維園出發，十座高達4米的巨型木偶率領約500名來自本地學校的年輕參與者。
主辦單位表示，巨型木偶周末會在公園內驚喜現身供市民合照，活動免費開放予公眾。
